changelog: **Org-wide weekly-report compliance: one definition, two admin endpoints** (#1917, story #1916). Every weekly-report read used to take a single `relationId`; the compliance screen (#1918) needs a whole programme at once and one meaning of "compliant". `src/lib/weeklyReportCompliance.ts` (pure, unit-tested at 100% lines, floor added) owns it: the **internship window** is read from the relation's stage history (first move into `INTERNSHIP_IN_PROGRESS_450` → last move out, `startDate` fallback for a relation sitting in the stage without one — one lookup, so #1622's Program term dates become a one-function change); an **owed week** is a full UTC week inside that window that has already ended (`firstFullUtcWeek`, the attention queue's rule); a DRAFT is **missing**; **late** means first handed in after the week it *covers* ended; **rate** is `null`, never 0%, while nothing is owed. `GET /api/admin/weekly-reports` (ADMIN, `mentorship` capability, tenant filter by hand) returns one row per interning relation — mentee, mentor, company, cohort, expected/submitted/reviewed/missing/late, the missing and late weeks, rate, last hand-in — with `cohortId`/`mentorId`/`companyId`/`status`/`from`/`to` filters, page/pageSize (cap 100) and an exact org roll-up up to 500 relations; a constant number of queries per request (count, page, stage moves, reports — no N+1). `GET /api/admin/weekly-reports/[relationId]` is the week-by-week drill-down, authorized through the existing `canReadWeeklyReports`. New nullable `WeeklyReport.submittedAt` stamps the FIRST hand-in (POST as SUBMITTED, PATCH DRAFT→SUBMITTED; kept on resubmission after changes were requested) — `updatedAt` moves on every edit and review, so lateness had no honest source; older rows read as "unknown", never late. `seed:demo` now records the internship stage in each intern's history and seeds every owed week with a deliberate mix (missing, late, awaiting review, sent back, this week's draft). New `e2e/admin-weekly-report-compliance.spec.ts`; `e2e/weekly-reports.spec.ts` asserts the `submittedAt` stamp.
